input_artifacts.role: Only anonymous mathematical input artifact read.

decoder.mathematical_inputs: Only the exact anonymous Lean statement and its approved definition context in the named packet.
decoder.method: Direct semantic reconstruction of displayed binders and conjunctions; no theorem proof or source-fidelity verdict.

reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space, equipped with its Borel measurable structure and canonical volume; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E→ℝ, α,β∈ℝ≥0 and η∈ℝ. There are exactly six displayed hypothesis binders:
(hα) 0<α as a real number;
(hαβ) α≤β;
(hV) V is C² over ℝ;
(hH) for every x,v∈E, α‖v‖²≤(D(DV)(x)[v])[v]≤β‖v‖², where these are the actual Fréchet derivatives of V;
(hη) 0<η;
(hβη) βη≤1.
All conclusions below hold under these hypotheses.

Definitions used in the conclusions. Write Q=E×E, Ω=ℕ→ℝ, and ℝ≥0 for nonnegative real time. For y,xRef∈E put c=y−η∇V(xRef). For real t and z=(x,p)∈Q define
Φ(y,xRef,t,(x,p))=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p).
Put δ(x,xRef)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), define
S(xRef,(x,p))=(x,p−[2⟨p,δ(x,xRef)⟩/‖δ(x,xRef)‖²]δ(x,xRef)),
and rate(xRef,(x,p))=√η max(0,⟨p,δ(x,xRef)⟩).
The division in S is Lean real division, so division by zero gives zero. For t≥0 let Λ(y,xRef,z,t)=∫₀ᵗ rate(xRef,Φ(y,xRef,s,z)) ds. For e≥0, τ(y,xRef,z,e) is the infimum in ℝ≥0∪{∞} of all t≥0 such that Λ(y,xRef,z,t)−e≥0; the empty infimum is ∞, and time zero is included.

A record is either a live pair (a,z)∈ℝ≥0×Q or a stopped marker. Starting from the live record (0,z₀), record(y,xRef,z₀,e,n) applies n successive updates, using threshold e(k) at update k, with k starting at zero. A stopped record remains stopped. From a live record (a,z), the next record is stopped if τ(y,xRef,z,e(k))=∞; otherwise, writing u for that finite hitting time, it is the live record (a+u,S(xRef,Φ(y,xRef,u,z))). Let P be the countable product on Ω of unit-rate exponential probability measures on real coordinates, and let ε(w)(k)=max(w(k),0), regarded as a nonnegative real number. For fixed y,xRef,z₀,w, eventTime(n) is the time of record(y,xRef,z₀,ε(w),n), or ∞ for a stopped record. Define I(y,xRef,z₀,T,n)={w:eventTime(n)≤T<eventTime(n+1)}. These definitions do not assert that such an n exists for every trajectory or almost every trajectory.

Let R(x,p)=(x,−p), Vᵧ(x)=V(x)+‖x−y‖²/(2η), γ be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian on E, and
μᵧ=volume.tilted(x↦−Vᵧ(x)), νᵧ=μᵧ⊗γ.
Explicitly, the density defining μᵧ relative to canonical volume is ofReal(exp(−Vᵧ(x))/∫ exp(−Vᵧ(u)) du). Here the tilt is the specified normalized-density definition, not an unspecified multiple of exp(−Vᵧ).

There exists one global function Z:E→E→Q→ℝ≥0→Ω→Q with all the following properties.

1. Z is jointly measurable in (y,xRef,z₀,T,w) with the displayed product measurable structures. For every y,xRef,z₀,w,s≥0,n and live pair (a,z), if w∈I(y,xRef,z₀,s,n) and record(y,xRef,z₀,ε(w),n) is the live record (a,z), then Z(y,xRef,z₀,s,w)=Φ(y,xRef,s−a,z), with s−a taken first as truncated nonnegative subtraction and then coerced to a real time. For every y,xRef,z₀,w,s, if no n satisfies w∈I(y,xRef,z₀,s,n), then Z(y,xRef,z₀,s,w)=z₀. Separately, for every fixed y,xRef,z₀, Z(y,xRef,z₀,0,w)=z₀ for P-almost every w. This last assertion has no single common exceptional set quantified uniformly over all initial parameters.

2. For every fixed y,xRef and T≥0 define, on raw real-valued functions G on Q,
op_T G(z)=∫ G(Z(y,xRef,z,T,w)) dP(w).
The endpoint map (z,w)↦Z(y,xRef,z,T,w) is measure preserving from (Q×Ω,νᵧ⊗P) to (Q,νᵧ): it is measurable and its pushforward measure is exactly νᵧ. Furthermore, for every pair of measurable raw functions F,G:Q→ℝ and every pair of real constants C_F,C_G satisfying C_F≥0, C_G≥0, |F(z)|≤C_F and |G(z)|≤C_G for every z, both functions F·op_T G and (G∘R)·op_T(F∘R) are νᵧ-integrable, and
∫ F(z) op_T G(z) dνᵧ(z)=∫ G(Rz) op_T(F∘R)(z) dνᵧ(z).
The bound constants are universally quantified admissible bounds, not extra existential constants.

3. For every measurable raw G:Q→ℝ, the map (y,xRef,z,T)↦∫ G(Z(y,xRef,z,T,w)) dP(w) is jointly measurable. This measurability assertion alone assumes no boundedness of G and asserts no integrability for unbounded G. In addition, for every real C≥0 such that |G(z)|≤C for all z, and for every y,xRef,z,T, the function w↦G(Z(y,xRef,z,T,w)) is P-integrable and its integral has absolute value at most C. The integrability and bound here are for every initial state, not merely almost every initial state.

4. There exists one measurable probability-fiber kernel Kphase from indices (((y,xRef),z),T)∈((E×E)×Q)×ℝ≥0 to Q such that, for every y,xRef,z,T,
Kphase((((y,xRef),z),T))=map(Z(y,xRef,z,T,·),P).
For every fixed y,xRef,T the kernel z↦Kphase((((y,xRef),z),T)) leaves νᵧ invariant, meaning νᵧ.bind(that kernel)=νᵧ. This is a global kernel witness for the same Z.

5. Inside this same kernel witness, for every fixed y,xRef there exists a family A:ℝ≥0→(L²(νᵧ;ℝ)→L²(νᵧ;ℝ)) of bounded real linear operators. Here L² is the real Hilbert quotient by almost-everywhere equality, not a space of pointwise-distinguished raw functions; coercion of an L² class to a function chooses a globally strongly measurable representative. This family satisfies:
(a) A(0)=Id, and for each L² class f, A(t)f→f in L² norm as nonnegative t→0.
(b) For every T and every L² class f, for νᵧ-almost every z the chosen representative of f is integrable against Kphase((((y,xRef),z),T)); and the chosen representative of A(T)f agrees νᵧ-almost everywhere with z↦∫ f(z′) dKphase((((y,xRef),z),T))(z′).
(c) For every T,f, if f≥0 νᵧ-almost everywhere then A(T)f≥0 νᵧ-almost everywhere. This is preservation of scalar pointwise nonnegativity modulo null sets, not the assertion ⟨A(T)f,f⟩≥0.
(d) For every T≥0 and every r∈ℝ there exists hr:MemLp(z↦r,2,νᵧ), and A(T) fixes exactly the L² class hr.toLp(z↦r).
(e) For every T, ‖A(T)‖≤1. For every raw G:Q→ℝ and every witness hG:MemLp(G,2,νᵧ), set opG(z)=∫ G(Z(y,xRef,z,T,w)) dP(w). For νᵧ-almost every z, the integrand in this P integral is integrable; there exists hOp:MemLp(opG,2,νᵧ) with A(T)(hG.toLp G)=hOp.toLp opG; and
∫ |opG(z)|² dνᵧ(z)≤∫ |G(z)|² dνᵧ(z).
The raw G in this assertion needs the stated MemLp witness, not an additional pointwise boundedness or global Measurable hypothesis.

6. For each fixed y,xRef, inside the chosen A witness there exists hR asserting that R preserves νᵧ. Let J be the actual canonical real linear isometry on L²(νᵧ) given by pullback by R using hR. For every L² class f its chosen representative satisfies Jf(z)=f(Rz) for νᵧ-almost every z; J(Jf)=f as an equality of classes; and for every T the real Hilbert adjoint satisfies A(T)*=J∘A(T)∘J.

7. Still within these witnesses, there exists hfst asserting that the position projection fst:Q→E preserves measure from νᵧ to the already defined μᵧ. Let B:L²(μᵧ;ℝ)→L²(νᵧ;ℝ) be the actual canonical real linear isometry given by pullback by fst using hfst, and let M=B* be its Hilbert adjoint, a bounded real linear map in the reverse direction. For every L² class f on E, Bf(x,p)=f(x) for νᵧ-almost every (x,p). One has ‖B‖≤1, ‖M‖≤1 and M∘B=Id on L²(μᵧ). For every raw G:Q→ℝ and every hG:MemLp(G,2,νᵧ), set gbar(x)=∫ G(x,p) dγ(p). For μᵧ-almost every x, p↦G(x,p) is γ-integrable; and there exists hbar:MemLp(gbar,2,μᵧ) such that M(hG.toLp G)=hbar.toLp gbar. For every L² class f on E, J(Bf)=Bf, and M∘J=M.

8. Define, from these very operators, Kpos(T)=M∘A(T)∘B on L²(μᵧ;ℝ); this is a defined compression, not an unrelated existential position operator. Then Kpos(0)=Id. For every T≥0, Kpos(T)*=Kpos(T) and ‖Kpos(T)‖≤1. For every raw f:E→ℝ and every hf:MemLp(f,2,μᵧ), define
kTf(x)=∫ [∫ f(fst(Z(y,xRef,(x,p),T,w))) dP(w)] dγ(p).
For μᵧ-almost every x, for γ-almost every p, the inner P integrand is P-integrable. Also, for μᵧ-almost every x, the function p↦∫ f(fst(Z(y,xRef,(x,p),T,w))) dP(w) is γ-integrable. There exists hk:MemLp(kTf,2,μᵧ) with Kpos(T)(hf.toLp f)=hk.toLp kTf as an equality of real L² classes.

Scope and limits. The existential order is one global Z, one global Kphase subordinate to it, then for each y,xRef an A and its hR and hfst witnesses. The hr,hOp,hbar,hk witnesses occur under their displayed universal parameters. Every almost-everywhere statement has the parameter scope just stated; no simultaneous null set over uncountably many parameters or over all L² classes is asserted. In particular, the final iterated almost-everywhere assertion is μᵧ-almost every x followed by γ-almost every p, for fixed y,xRef,T,f,hf. Equalities of operators and L² classes are exact in their respective quotient spaces; the associated representative formulas hold only almost everywhere.

There is no asserted semigroup or Chapman–Kolmogorov identity, restart law, temporal Markov property for trajectories, strong continuity at every positive time, càdlàg/sample-path regularity, nonexplosion, or almost-sure existence of a bracketing n. There is no asserted exponential convergence, spectral gap, mixing bound, or positive quadratic-form bound for A(T) or Kpos(T). Self-adjointness of Kpos(T) and order preservation of A(T) must not be relabeled as nonnegative quadratic-form positivity. The locally defined history-admissibility set named A in the preliminary lets is distinct from the later existential operator family A. The preliminary definitions history, Rec, Hist, readTime, Δ, Prefix, m, zAt, K, qReal, q, the history set A, N, liveTime, d, survival, weight, C, Path, Ψ, Γ and ρ do not occur in the asserted conclusions through any used definition; their mere introduction asserts no event-density, prefix-law, count-law, path-law, survival-law, density normalization, or path reversal identity.

existential_witnesses.name: Z
existential_witnesses.meaning: Jointly measurable total function with the displayed interval formula, fallback, initialization, and all subsequent properties.

existential_witnesses.name: Kphase
existential_witnesses.meaning: Single measurable Markov kernel whose every fiber equals the endpoint pushforward of P.

existential_witnesses.name: A
existential_witnesses.scope: For each y,xRef under the same Kphase
existential_witnesses.meaning: Nonnegative-time indexed bounded real linear operators on the real L² quotient.

existential_witnesses.name: hr
existential_witnesses.meaning: MemLp witness for the constant raw function; its class is fixed by A(T).

existential_witnesses.name: hOp
existential_witnesses.meaning: MemLp witness for the raw P-expectation opG; its class is the specified A(T) image.

existential_witnesses.name: hR
existential_witnesses.scope: For each fixed y,xRef inside A
existential_witnesses.meaning: MeasurePreserving R νᵧ νᵧ; defines the canonical pullback J.

existential_witnesses.name: hfst
existential_witnesses.scope: After hR for each fixed y,xRef,A
existential_witnesses.meaning: MeasurePreserving fst νᵧ μᵧ; defines the canonical pullback B and therefore M=B*.

existential_witnesses.name: hbar
existential_witnesses.meaning: MemLp witness for the Gaussian momentum average gbar; its class is the specified M image.

existential_witnesses.name: hk
existential_witnesses.meaning: MemLp witness for kTf; its class equals the Kpos(T) image.

dependent_defined_operators.J: Canonical real linear isometry Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ R hR, not an arbitrary involution.
dependent_defined_operators.B: Canonical real linear isometry Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ fst hfst, not an arbitrary embedding.

unused_preliminary_lets: A (history-admissibility set, not the operator family)

domains.E: Any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including rank zero.
domains.αβ: Nonnegative real numbers; compared and multiplied as real numbers where coerced.
domains.time: ℝ≥0 for T,s and hitting times; Φ accepts real time
domains.sample: Ω=ℕ→ℝ with coordinate-product measurable structure and P the countable product of expMeasure 1
domains.μ: Normalized exponential tilt of canonical volume by −Vy
domains.L2: Lp ℝ 2 of the indicated measure: real Hilbert space modulo almost-everywhere equality; chosen representatives are not pointwise canonical values.

quantifiers.ambient: For every E with the displayed typeclasses, V:E→ℝ, α β:ℝ≥0 and η:ℝ, and all six displayed hypothesis witnesses.
quantifiers.witness_order: ∃ Z, [global conjuncts] ∧ ∃ Kphase, IsMarkovKernel Kphase ∧ [fiber equalities] ∧ [invariance] ∧ ∀ y xRef, ∃ A, [operator clauses] ∧ ∃ hR, [J clauses] ∧ ∃ hfst, [B,M,Kpos clauses].
quantifiers.process_interval: ∀ y xRef,z₀,w,s,n,a: membership in I and the specified live record imply the flow formula.
quantifiers.fallback: ∀ y xRef,z₀,w,s: absence of any bracketing n implies Z=z₀.
quantifiers.initialization: ∀ y xRef,z₀, for P-almost every w: Z(y,xRef,z₀,0,w)=z₀.
quantifiers.bounded_duality: ∀ y xRef,T,F,G,C_F,C_G: Measurable F/G, nonnegative bounds, and global pointwise bounds imply both integrabilities and equality.
quantifiers.expectation_measurability: ∀ G: Measurable G implies joint parameter measurability; then ∀ C≥0 with a global bound, ∀ y xRef,z,T, sample integrability and absolute expectation bound.
quantifiers.kernel: One Kphase; ∀ y xRef,z,T fiber equality; ∀ y xRef,T invariance.
quantifiers.kernel_L2_representation: For each fixed y,xRef,A, ∀ T,f:L²: νᵧ-AE kernel-fiber integrability and νᵧ-AE representative equality.
quantifiers.A_order: For each fixed y,xRef,A, ∀ T,f: f≥0 νᵧ-AE implies A(T)f≥0 νᵧ-AE.
quantifiers.A_constants: ∀ T,r, ∃ hr:MemLp(constant r,2,νᵧ), exact fixed-class identity.
quantifiers.A_raw_L2: ∀ T, norm bound and ∀ G,hG:MemLp(G,2,νᵧ), νᵧ-AE P-integrability, ∃ hOp, class identity, and square-integral inequality.
quantifiers.J: ∃ hR; ∀ f representative formula and involution; ∀ T adjoint identity.
quantifiers.projection: ∃ hfst; ∀ f position pullback formula; norm bounds and left-inverse identity; ∀ G,hG, μᵧ-AE Gaussian integrability and ∃ hbar with class identity; ∀ f, J(Bf)=Bf; M∘J=M.
quantifiers.position: Kpos(0)=Id; ∀ T, self-adjointness and norm bound; ∀ raw f,hf:MemLp(f,2,μᵧ), iterated μᵧ-AE then γ-AE P-integrability, μᵧ-AE outer γ-integrability, ∃ hk with exact class identity.

assumptions.statement: ∀ x v:E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖²≤(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v≤(β:ℝ)*‖v‖²

conclusion.process: One jointly measurable global Z; pointwise bracketed flow formula; pointwise fallback; fixed-parameter almost-sure initialization.
conclusion.measure_and_duality: Endpoint measure preservation and bounded measurable twisted integral duality, with both product integrabilities.
conclusion.expectation: Joint parameter measurability for every measurable raw observable; every-state integrability and bound for every globally bounded measurable observable.
conclusion.kernel: One probability-fiber kernel equal to every endpoint pushforward and leaving νᵧ invariant for each fixed parameter/time slice.
conclusion.real_L2: A(0)=Id; strong convergence to Id at time zero; kernel representative formula; order-nonnegativity preservation; exact preservation of all constant classes; contraction; raw L² expectation representation and square-integral bound.
conclusion.reversal: Canonical measure-preserving pullback J, representative formula, involution, and A(T)*=J A(T) J.
conclusion.marginalization: Canonical position pullback B, adjoint M, both norm ≤1, MB=Id, Gaussian-average representation, JB=B and MJ=M.
conclusion.position_compression: The actual Kpos=MAB has Kpos(0)=Id, is self-adjoint and contractive at every time, and has the stated iterated-expectation real-L² representation with all displayed integrability clauses.
nonconclusions: No trajectory Markov or restart law
No path regularity or nonexplosion assertion
No almost-sure coverage by bracketing events
No path/prefix/event-density or survival-distribution identity from unused lets
No mixing rate or spectral gap
No nonnegative quadratic-form assertion for A(T) or Kpos(T)
No uniform full-measure set across all parameters or all L² classes

scopes.initialization: P-null set may depend on y,xRef,z₀.
scopes.pointwise_process: The interval and fallback implications quantify all w; neither is only an AE assertion.
scopes.endpoint: For each fixed y,xRef,T, endpoint preservation is of νᵧ⊗P to νᵧ.
scopes.measurable_observables: Measurability is joint over y,xRef,z,T after fixing G; boundedness is needed only for the separate all-state integrability and bound.
scopes.kernel_L2: For fixed y,xRef,A,T,f, the fiber-integrability null set and representative-equality null set are with respect to νᵧ and can depend on these fixed values.
scopes.order: For fixed T,f, both the antecedent and consequent are νᵧ-AE scalar inequalities.
scopes.raw_phase_L2: For fixed y,xRef,A,T,G,hG, sample integrability is νᵧ-AE in z; operator image equality is equality of L² classes, not everywhere equality of opG and a representative.
scopes.reversal: J representative equality is νᵧ-AE separately for each f; involution and adjoint statements are exact operator/class equalities.
scopes.averaging: For fixed G,hG under chosen witnesses, Gaussian section integrability is μᵧ-AE in x; hbar identifies quotient classes.
scopes.position: For fixed y,xRef,T,f,hf and chosen operators, inner integrability is μᵧ-AE x then γ-AE p; outer integrability is μᵧ-AE x. hk identifies quotient classes.
scopes.continuity: Only ∀f, Tendsto(t↦A(t)f)(𝓝0)(𝓝f) on nonnegative time is stated; no family law or parameter measurability of A is asserted.
scopes.operator_positivity: Scalar AE order preservation of A is distinct from Hilbert quadratic-form positivity. Self-adjointness of Kpos does not assert a nonnegative quadratic form.
scopes.shadowed_name: The unused preliminary let A is a set of histories. The later existential A is an operator family and is the one occurring in the L² conclusions.

constant_dependencies.hypothesis_constants: α and β are nonnegative scalar bounds; α>0, α≤β and βη≤1. η>0 is the actual flow and confinement parameter.
constant_dependencies.exact_constants: Flow uses √η, 1/√η and η; S uses the exact factor 2; confinement denominator is 2η; P has rate 1; γ has covariance identity; all stated operator norm bounds are exactly 1.
constant_dependencies.bound_constants: C_F,C_G and C are arbitrary universally quantified real numbers required nonnegative and globally bounding their respective raw observables. They are not existential estimates or rates.
constant_dependencies.dependency_measures: μᵧ and νᵧ depend on E,V,η,y, not xRef. γ depends on E. P is the fixed unit-exponential countable product, independent of y,xRef,z,T.
constant_dependencies.dependency_process: Z is global in y,xRef,z,T,w and may depend on the fixed ambient data/hypotheses. Kphase is one global witness subordinate to this same Z.
constant_dependencies.dependency_operators: A may be chosen separately for each y,xRef; the proposition asserts no joint measurability of that choice. hR,hfst and their defined J,B,M,Kpos remain under those choices.
constant_dependencies.auxiliary_witnesses: hr may depend on T,r and the enclosing fixed data; hOp on T,G,hG; hbar on G,hG; hk on T,f,hf, each also on the enclosing y,xRef and selected witnesses.
constant_dependencies.absent_constants: No convergence-rate constant, spectral gap, mixing-time bound, temporal composition constant, or dimension-dependent estimate is asserted.

hashing_convention.packet_sha256: SHA256 of raw input artifact bytes, not the packet's embedded hash field.
hashing_convention.reconstructed_text_sha256: SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of reconstructed_theorem_text, without BOM and without an added terminal newline.
hashing_convention.decoder_run_sha256: Remove only the top-level decoder_run_sha256 field. Recursively sort object keys lexicographically, retain array order, serialize as compact JSON with no whitespace outside strings, preserve Unicode characters without ASCII escaping, encode as UTF-8 without BOM and with no terminal newline, then SHA256. This is the canonical sorted compact JSON convention used here.
hashing_convention.output_serialization: The saved artifact itself is pretty-printed JSON with LF line endings and a final LF. decoder_run_sha256 is not the raw-file SHA256.
